decisions.title: Never commit or push without asking
decisions.text: Do not commit or push changes to GitHub without explicit human approval.

decisions.title: Model routing
decisions.text: Use smaller models (haiku/sonnet class) for small tasks; use opus or other expensive models only for critical tasks such as security review of the masker.

decisions.title: Minimal comments
decisions.text: Do not write excessive comments in code.

decisions.title: Spec scope: MVP + local cache + AI triage
decisions.text: Implementation scope is core CLI, local verdict cache and allowlist, and --ai triage with one provider first. Redis and Tiger Cloud are non-goals.

decisions.title: Findings carry a remediation step
decisions.text: Each rule has a fix hint (rotate or revoke the credential, then load it from the environment or a secrets manager). Detector attaches it to the finding as 'fix' (FR-5, FR-7); the reporter prints it on its own line in text and as a key in JSON (T-3). Hints are rule-based and offline; AI triage (T-5) only rewrites the reason.

knowledge.title: Design source
knowledge.text: docs/architecture.html holds the architecture, rules table, data model, failure modes and test plan.
